observations: Photo 0 shows two black PlayStation controllers placed on top of a black rectangular console box. The console box has a small logo on the top left corner, possibly the PlayStation logo.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle. The console box has 'PS4' written on the front right corner in white letters.
Both controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models, with visible wear and scuff marks on the grips and buttons.
The console box is black, with a matte finish, and appears to be the original PS4 packaging. No other accessories or games are visible in the photos.
The watermark 'MURITALA MARTINS' is present on both photos, indicating the seller or listing platform.
